newsitem.title: CHINA: China has 6.2 mln mobile phone users by end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: China has 6.2 mln mobile phone users by end-Oct.

text.p: China had 6.2 million signed-up mobile phone users by the end of October and the market in cellular communications was expected to further boom next year, the official Xinhua news agency said.
Industrial experts estimated the number of mobile phone users would surge to 10 million in 1997, before doubling to 20 million users by 2000, the agency said in a report late on Friday.
Xinhua reported earlier this year that 4.57 million Chinese were using mobile telephones at the end of April.

In a separate report late on Friday, the agency said eastern China's Jiangxi province had decided to import equipment from Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy to develop a 400 million yuan ($48 million) GSM service.

The project, scheduled for completion by the end of August 1997, included the construction of six switching centers and the creation or expansion of more than 200 base stations, it said but gave no details of the scale of Nokia's involvement.
